options.name: label
options.description: Accessible name of the <nav> (aria-label), e.g. "Checkout progress". Must not be empty.

options.name: steps
options.type: readonly { id: string; label: string; description?: string; href?: string; status?: 'complete' | 'error'; optional?: boolean; disabled?: boolean }[]
options.description: Steps in order (at least one). Ids must be unique and non-empty; labels must be non-empty. status is consumer-owned; href renders a reachable step as a link.

options.name: value
options.description: Current step id. Must be the id of an existing step.

options.name: orientation
options.description: Layout. A horizontal stepper renders vertically when its container is 30rem wide or narrower.

options.name: linear
options.description: When true, a step after the current one is reachable only when every step before it has status 'complete'. Earlier steps are always reachable unless disabled.

options.name: direction
options.description: 'rtl' sets dir="rtl" on the <nav>; 'ltr' leaves the document direction in effect.

options.name: icons
options.description: Icon slot overrides for the step indicator.

properties.name: host
properties.description: Consumer host; its children are owned by the component.

methods.name: state
methods.description: Resolved state ('current' | 'complete' | 'error' | 'upcoming') of a step, or null for an unknown id.

methods.name: isReachable
methods.description: Whether the user can activate the step in the current state. False for the current step, disabled steps, and unknown ids.

methods.name: select
methods.description: Make a step current programmatically. No events and no reachability check. Throws STEPPER_OPTIONS for an unknown id.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Merge, validate, and apply options. When the current id no longer exists and no value is given, the first step becomes current. No events.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Remove rendering, host classes, listeners, and the configuration subscription.

events.name: aui-navigate
events.detail: { id: string; index: number; step: StepperStep; previous: string }
events.description: The user activated a reachable step (unmodified primary click, Enter, or Space on a button). preventDefault keeps the current step and stops link navigation.

events.name: aui-change
events.description: The current step changed after an uncanceled aui-navigate.

cssClasses.name: aui-stepper--horizontal | --vertical
cssClasses.description: Orientation modifiers on the host (the configured orientation).
